note: Share of mainland Spain's grid-connected solar PV capacity on horizontal single-axis trackers. Derived on the 2024 back-cast: the mix of the fixed-tilt and tracker profiles that best reproduces the measured hourly solar output of 2024 (least squares, 0.60), cross-checked with the literature: about 30% of the fleet of 2016 (4.7 GW) tracked (Victoria & Andresen 2019) and trackers went into roughly 70% of the 2024 build (Mordor Intelligence). See doc/validation_log.md.
